title: Generalized Bogomolov--Gieseker inequalities via Frobenius
summary: We establish a Bogomolov--Gieseker-type inequality for tilt-semistable objects on smooth projective varieties of dimension $\geq 3$, in the spirit of the Bayer--Macrì--Toda conjecture. A key ingredient is an analysis of the action of the Frobenius morphism on tilt-semistable objects. As an application, we prove the Castelnuovo Bound Conjecture, up to an explicit constant term.
